verdict.rationale: Sierra's Agent SDK lets teams write journeys as code and 'track changes' (version-control-like workflow), and its release-governance blog describes merge approval workflows (review) and split-traffic gradual releases plus proactive Agent Checks/Simulations (safety net for changes). However, no explicit rollback/revert mechanism or version-history UI is documented. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert capability, a versioned history/diff view, and independent confirmation these features work as described.
